sections.Profile:
"Heads Up!" is a competitive pinball game developed by Multimorphic for their P3 Pinball Platform, released in August 2019. Designed for two players, it enables real-time head-to-head matches either on two connected P3 machines in the same location or over the internet.

- Manufacturer: Multimorphic
- Years made: 2021
- In production: yes
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, 2020s, Original Theme, Solid State, P3, Module Game
